title: Arcline
description_en: Read the arc. Time your shot. Move freely with the thumbstick, hold to charge and release to fire through 100 changing battlefields. Choose an agile rover or a heavy defender and conquer ten worlds of dunes, ice, craters and towering ridges.
audience_intent: General audience 13+, not specifically made for kids
progress: 100 levels; SDK cloud save in YouTube, device-local save in standalone browser
status: Not submitted; real-device QA and certification pending
